description.value:
You've stepped into a realm of artistic expression that many would consider unnatural, or even taboo. Through careful application of your Craft, you can perform a 3-hour operation that requires a stable work surface. At the end of the operation, your heart is replaced with a unique magical device. You no longer need to sleep, and falling unconscious no longer causes your pawns to become Inactive (src/pawns/lifecycle.js already checks for this feat's slug). Although you don't need to sleep, you still need 3 hours of downtime in each 24-hour period to maintain your heart's delicate mechanisms; skipping this maintenance has the same effects that going without sleep has for other creatures. You gain the Vital Surge reaction.

Vital Surge ⟳

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points.

Requirements Your prosthetic heart doesn't have the broken condition.

Your heart surges against the oncoming doom, keeping you in the fight. You remain at 1 Hit Point, and your heart gains the broken condition.

Your heart still performs its organic functions while it's broken, but removing its broken condition is a 1-hour activity that requires your full attention.

Vital Surge itself isn't auto-triggered; the GM and player apply it by hand and add the Prosthetic Heart (Broken) effect.
